sections.Profile:
The "No Fear: Dangerous Sports" pinball machine, released by Williams in 1995, was designed by Steve Ritchie and themed around extreme sports, in collaboration with the No Fear clothing brand. This game features a range of adrenaline-pumping sports, including skydiving, free climbing, water skiing, and car racing.
